judged_text: `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` raises NoMethodError (nil['id']) whenever the embed_category lookup returns no row — the default state on fresh installs (the categories table is empty until db:seed and unset settings have no site_settings row) and for any existing site whose embed_category value is empty, an id rather than a name, or a since-renamed/deleted category name. `db:migrate` crashes mid-deploy for most existing installs and every fresh install, blocking the rollout; the `if category_id == 0` uncategorized fallback at line 14 is unreachable because the crash at line 11 happens first, so the deploy stays broken until the migration is patched.

adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` on the result of a SQL join against `site_settings` and `categories`. If that query returns zero rows (e.g., no `site_settings` row named `embed_category`, empty/blank value, renamed/deleted category, or categories not yet present), `execute(...)[0]` is `nil` and `nil['id']` raises `NoMethodError`, crashing the migration before the `category_id == 0` fallback can run.
